name: ithmb-codec-web
description: Free private browser-based .ithmb (Apple iThumbnail) file decoder.

scripts.test:quick: playwright test tests/pages.spec.js tests/ithmb-decoder.spec.js tests/gallery.spec.js tests/upload.spec.js tests/quality.spec.js tests/a11y.spec.js tests/seo-metadata.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.ci: npm run lint:modules && npm run lint:i18n && playwright test
scripts.lint:modules: for f in ithmb-decoder/*.js; do npx --yes acorn --ecma2022 --module "$f" 2>/dev/null || { echo "FAIL: $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo "All modules pass"

author: ITHMB Codec
